body: Round 1 (origin/main..2ff92578), P1: empty `gh pr checks` output passed condition 2. Fixed in f2d1ffd2: a non-empty array is required, else hold (test: holds_on_a_missing... empty checks.json).

Round 1, P1: regime-counters.sh --history-only never prints S1 lines, so condition 6's S1 half could not fail (the test fake hid it). Fixed in f2d1ffd2: the counters run with --pr; the fake now copies the real contract. Round 2's residual (no ledger) fixed in f6adaea8.

Round 1, P1: a blocked or incorrect audit with no findings passed condition 3. Fixed in f2d1ffd2: blocked holds, incorrect needs an unfixed finding, all records-scope; the audit must name the task and head.
Round 1, P2: the tests cap regex missed '500 under `tests/`'. Fixed in f2d1ffd2 (case: 500 under -> 0 under gives revise).
Round 1, P2: any non-empty disposition passed. Fixed in f2d1ffd2: fixed:<sha> or not-applicable:...; evidence=... only (case: 'later' gives revise).

Round 1, P2: --apply merged without the Q-C shadow gate the threat table claims. Fixed in f2d1ffd2: four agreeing machine/human rows at the end of verdict-shadow.tsv; f6adaea8 counts four distinct PRs.

Round 1, P2: --apply ran helpers from a checkout the PR may control. f2d1ffd2's HEAD-based guard was bypassable (round 2 P2, head~1); fixed in f6adaea8: scripts/, .schemas/ and the tracked task files must equal origin/main, no untracked files there (case: a checkout at pr~1 is refused).

Round 1, P2: stale .running files hold their slots forever. Declared residual (fails closed): --once names the held slots when requests wait (f2d1ffd2, message fixed in f6adaea8) and the header says a killed pool's files must be removed.

Round 1, P2: a failed run's last transcript lines (unmasked) reached the queue's .log and .rejected. Fixed in f2d1ffd2: only the marker 'the codex transcript mentions 429' leaves; test in be70b5c8 (no transcript text in the log).

Round 1, P3: --loop limit (fixed: --limit 200), audit task_id unchecked (fixed), ERR trap in functions (set -E, f2d1ffd2), 429 anywhere (marker, word match in f6adaea8); declared residuals: date-only generated_at passes the checker's format, stop-path holds write no verdict JSON (no head or task to name it by), ACCEPTANCE before the merge (the spec's order), the differential prompt is a paraphrase, request names with whitespace (the task grammar excludes them).
Round 2 (2ff92578..f2d1ffd2), P2: with a record lacking a ledger and gh failing, the counters printed no S1 line. Fixed in f6adaea8: the record must carry a ledger array, else hold (case added).

Round 2, P3: set -E printed 'internal error' from conditional substitutions (fixed: the trap is silent in subshells); the held-slot message printed a literal glob (fixed: compgen); four rows of one PR unlocked --apply (fixed: distinct PRs); a duplicate FAILURE entry of a required check passed (fixed: every entry SUCCESS; case added); --apply does not run the step-10 gate: declared, the gate is out of scope and the threat row is the orchestrator's text.
